artists.source_line: From April 10–12, 2026, the city center of Erlangen will transform into a vibrant hub of Latin American joy and passion. Sabor Latino Entertainment presents the 2nd edition of the SBK Spring Festival, bringing together dancers from all over Germany and across Europe to celebrate a weekend filled with music, passion, and movement.

features.rationale: The description advertises a Salsa big band concert, which is live music.
The text promises shows that will captivate attendees.
Three separate dancefloors mean more than one dance floor.
The festival offers more than 40 dance workshops.

features.quote: no matter whether you’re a beginner or an experienced dancer
features.rationale: The workshops are explicitly open to beginners as well as experienced dancers.
